# weft_image (Resource)

Declares an image URL — mirrors the mock HCL `image` block. Pulls the image via weft's PullImage RPC and optionally applies image-level patches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# weft_image pulls and caches an image locally via the weft daemon, then
# (optionally) patches the cached copy once so every VM cloned from it
# inherits the changes — no per-instance disk.patch block needed.
resource "weft_image" "debian_13" {
  from     = "https://cloud.debian.org/images/cloud/trixie/latest/debian-13-genericcloud-arm64.raw"
  checksum = "https://cloud.debian.org/images/cloud/trixie/latest/SHA512SUMS"

  patch {
    add {
      content = <<-EOF
        GRUB_TERMINAL_OUTPUT="console"
        GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="console=tty0 console=hvc0"
      EOF
      dst     = "/etc/default/grub.d/99-console.cfg"
      trigger = "grub-mkconfig"
    }
  }
}

resource "weft_instance" "debian" {
  name = "web-01"
  disk {
    from = weft_image.debian_13.from
  }
  ssh {
    user         = "debian"
    keypair_path = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from` (String) Fully-resolved image URL — matches mock HCL image.from.

### Optional

- `checksum` (String) Checksum file URL — matches mock HCL image.checksum.
- `patch` (Block, Optional) Patch operations applied once to the cached image (shared by all VMs cloned from it). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--patch))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Image ID (mirrors `from`).

<a id="nestedblock--patch"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patch`

Optional:

- `add` (Block List) Files to write into the disk image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--patch--add))
- `del` (Block List) Files to remove from the disk image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--patch--del))
- `mod` (Block List) RE2-regex substitutions applied in-place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--patch--mod))

<a id="nestedblock--patch--add"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patch.add`

Required:

- `content` (String) Literal file content.
- `dst` (String) Absolute destination path inside the disk image.

Optional:

- `trigger` (String) Post-add trigger. Supported: "grub-mkconfig".


<a id="nestedblock--patch--del"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patch.del`

Required:

- `dst` (String) Absolute path to delete.


<a id="nestedblock--patch--mod"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patch.mod`

Required:

- `dst` (String) Absolute path of the file to modify.
- `new` (String) Replacement text. May reference $1, ${name}.
- `old` (String) RE2 pattern to match.
